name: MonarchActivityTimeline
title: ActivityTimeline
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn with LazyListScope.stickyHeader per day; MonarchAvatar, MonarchCollapsible, MonarchTag, MonarchLoadMore, MonarchSkeleton, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchInlineErrorRetry; android.icu.text.DateFormat and android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString for times
summary: A vertical feed of events (actor, verb, target, time and a marker) grouped under sticky day headings, with expandable details and Load more.
whenToUse: For the history of a record, an audit trail in context or a project's activity: who did what, and when.
whenNotToUse: For a sequence of steps someone must complete, use MonarchStepper; for messages people exchange, a chat or comment thread; for notifications that need action, a notification list.
api: @Composable fun MonarchActivityTimeline(events: List<MonarchActivityTimelineEvent>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, groupByDay: Boolean = true, marker: MonarchActivityTimelineMarker = MonarchActivityTimelineMarker.Dot, density: MonarchActivityTimelineDensity = MonarchActivityTimelineDensity.Regular, expandedIds: Set<String>? = null, onExpandedChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, loading: Boolean = false, failed: Boolean = false, hasMore: Boolean = false, loadingMore: Boolean = false, loadMoreFailed: Boolean = false, now: Long? = null, timeZone: String? = null, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(), labels: MonarchActivityTimelineLabels = MonarchActivityTimelineLabels(), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onLoadMore: (() -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(id: String, verb: String, time: Long, actor: MonarchActivityTimelineActor? = null, target: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, tags: List<String> = emptyList(), body: String? = null, details: String? = null)
class MonarchActivityTimelineActor(name: String, image: Painter? = null, kind: MonarchActivityTimelineActorKind = MonarchActivityTimelineActorKind.Person, seed: String? = null)
enum class MonarchActivityTimelineActorKind { Person, Automation, System }

class MonarchActivityTimelineLabels(list: String? = null, today: String? = null, yesterday: String? = null, automated: String? = null, details: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, error: String? = null, loadMore: MonarchLoadMoreLabels = MonarchLoadMoreLabels())

options.name: events
options.description: The events, newest first or oldest first; the order is kept. Each has an id, a verb, a time (epoch milliseconds, UTC) and an optional actor, target, icon, tone, tags, body and details. The app filters them; put filter controls above the timeline.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the list. Give the feed a bounded height, or let it fill a screen or pane.

options.name: groupByDay
options.description: Groups events under Today, Yesterday and dates in timeZone.

options.name: marker
options.description: A dot in the event's tone, or the actor's avatar. An event's icon always wins.

options.name: density
options.description: Regular, or Compact for side panels.

options.name: expandedIds
options.description: The ids of events whose details are open. null lets the timeline keep its own set.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called with the new set when details open or close.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows three placeholder rows for the first page.

options.name: failed
options.description: Shows the error message, with Try again when onRetry is set.

options.name: hasMore
options.description: Shows Load more after the feed when onLoadMore is set.

options.name: loadingMore
options.description: Load more shows that the next page is loading.

options.name: loadMoreFailed
options.description: Load more shows that the next page failed, with a retry.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times and day headings. The current time when null, refreshed every minute; pass a fixed time in tests and screenshots.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone of day boundaries and dates. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: contentPadding
options.description: The padding around the feed inside the list, such as for a Scaffold's bars.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Activity, Today, Yesterday, Automated, Details, the empty, loading and error texts and the Load more strings.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries the first page after a failure.

states.name: default
states.description: Day headings that stick to the top while their events scroll, then each event: the marker on a line that joins the day's events, the sentence with the actor and target in bold, the relative time and tags, the body.

states.name: automated
states.description: Automation and system actors get an "Automated" tag after the time.

states.name: details open
states.description: The Details disclosure shows the event's details under it.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three placeholder rows, read as "Loading activity".

states.name: failed
states.description: MonarchInlineErrorRetry with Try again, or the error text alone without onRetry.

states.name: more
states.description: MonarchLoadMore after the feed, with its loading and failed states.

appearance: Day headings are subheading text on the canvas color. Dots are 8dp with a surface ring and a subtle outline: neutral in the strong border color, other tones in their solid color; icon markers are tinted in the tone's strong color (muted text when neutral) inside a surface circle. The line is the subtle border color, the time muted caption text and tags small Monarch tags. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Built on a LazyColumn with a stickyHeader per day, as the plan says, so long histories stay fast and headings stay in view; iOS uses a VStack so it can sit inside other scrolling content. As a result the Android timeline scrolls itself and needs a bounded height when it is placed inside a scrolling page; state and contentPadding are offered for that. The web takes rich content for the verb, object, meta, body and details; here they are strings, tags and an icon slot, and a link to the record belongs in the app's navigation. The web's object is target, because object is a Kotlin keyword. Times are epoch milliseconds in UTC and avatars a Painter, following the Monarch conventions. The web accent tone is MonarchTone.Accent. The filters slot is not offered: put the controls above the timeline. The web day heading level option has no meaning here: headings are headings. The web locale and timeZone options are the device locale and the timeZone parameter. Details use MonarchCollapsible, which says Expanded or Collapsed, instead of Show and Hide titles. iOS uses the same names, except target (iOS object), image (iOS avatarURL) and the Kotlin-style booleans (groupByDay, loading, failed, loadingMore, loadMoreFailed).
accessibility: Each event's sentence, time, tags and body are one element read as the sentence, its absolute date and time, "Automated" for rules, its tags and its body, such as "Ana Ruiz moved Acme renewal, Mar 4, 2026, 2:00 PM, Negotiation". The relative time is visual.
Markers, avatars and the line are hidden from TalkBack.
Details are a MonarchCollapsible after the event: a control named "Details" with Expanded or Collapsed, at least 48dp high.
Loading is one element read as "Loading activity" with an indeterminate progress.
A feed that is not grouped by day is named "Activity".
Text wraps and scales with the font size.
edgeCases: Days appear in the order of their first event, so an oldest-first feed reads oldest day first.
Day boundaries follow timeZone (the device's zone by default); an event near midnight can move to another day in another zone.
Events from another year get the year in their day heading.
An event without an actor reads as its verb and target only.
Load more is hidden while the first page is loading or failed, and without onLoadMore.
Event ids must be unique: they are the list keys.
The sentence joins actor, verb and target with spaces; languages that need another order should pass the whole sentence as the verb.
Sticky headings use the canvas color; on another background they show as a band.
Relative times refresh every minute when now is null.

examples.webExample: Task activity with filters and details
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    MonarchSegmentedControl(
        options = filters.map { it.second },
        selectedIndex = filters.indexOfFirst { it.first == filter },
        onSelect = { filter = filters[it].first },
    )
    MonarchActivityTimeline(
        events = listOf(
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id = {{events.0.id}},
                verb = {{events.0.verb}},
                time = {{events.0.time|millis}},
                actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.0.actor}}),
                target = {{events.0.object}},
                tone = {{events.0.tone|tone}},
                detailRows = listOf(
                    MonarchActivityTimelineDetail({{events.0.details.0.label}}, {{events.0.details.0.value}}),
                    MonarchActivityTimelineDetail({{events.0.details.1.label}}, {{events.0.details.1.value}}),
                ),
            ),
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id = {{events.1.id}},
                verb = {{events.1.verb}},
                time = {{events.1.time|millis}},
                actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.1.actor}}),
                icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Pencil, contentDescription = null) },
                body = {{events.1.body}},
            ),
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id = {{events.2.id}},
                verb = {{events.2.verb}},
                time = {{events.2.time|millis}},
                actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.2.actor}}, kind = MonarchActivityTimelineActorKind.{{events.2.kind|pascal}}),
                target = {{events.2.object}},
                tags = listOf({{events.2.tag}}),
            ),
            MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
                id = {{events.3.id}},
                verb = {{events.3.verb}},
                time = {{events.3.time|millis}},
                actor = MonarchActivityTimelineActor({{events.3.actor}}),
                icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Plus, contentDescription = null) },
                tone = {{events.3.tone|tone}},
            ),
        ),
        expandedIds = expanded,
        onExpandedChange = { expanded = it },
        hasMore = true,
        now = {{now|millis}},
        timeZone = {{timeZone}},
        onLoadMore = {},
    )
}

examples.title: Paged, compact, in a side panel
examples.setup:
var loadingMore by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
val now = 1_772_636_400_000L
examples.code:
MonarchActivityTimeline(
    events = listOf(
        MonarchActivityTimelineEvent(
            id = "1",
            verb = "Ticket created from email",
            time = now,
            tone = MonarchTone.Success,
        ),
    ),
    modifier = Modifier.height(240.dp),
    groupByDay = false,
    density = MonarchActivityTimelineDensity.Compact,
    hasMore = true,
    loadingMore = loadingMore,
    now = now,
    onLoadMore = { loadingMore = true },
)
